rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party that engaged the broker
rules.requirement: Only a licensed broker or salesperson may charge a fee to find rental housing for prospective tenants. Any broker fee may be paid only by the party (landlord or tenant) who originally hired the broker and signed a contract with them.

coverage.notes: Applies to fees for finding dwelling accommodations or tenants through licensed brokers/salespersons.

rules.coverage_text: Applies to fees charged by people in the business of finding rental homes for prospective tenants, or tenants for landlords.

effective_dates.quoted_span: Text of section as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025.

rules.interaction: Replaces the earlier text of the section, which was effective until August 1, 2025 and only required a broker or salesman license.
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.

llm.notes: The section regulates broker fees. I classified it as application_screening_fees because it limits upfront charges to tenants. The earlier version, in effect until August 1, 2025, only required a license and is not recorded as a separate fee rule.
